subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

Neha stood beside my sister __through thick and thin.__
solution:
The correct answer is** 'under all circumstances'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'through thick and thin' **is** 'under all circumstances'.**
 
• **Through thick and thin: **through difficult times and situations. (सुख-दुख में, मुसीबतों में)
 
 
• *Example: I would stick to that **through thick and thin.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *under all circumstances.*
